official_catalogue_snapshot.comparison_rule: Equivalent documented user outcomes within the stated QuickPLS scope; no copied internals or numerical-identity claim.

release_policy.description: release_qualified is derived only from a current scoped method audit and a packaged acceptance report. Both reports must have passed=true and must identify this feature ID, current method version, and catalogue snapshot date.

features.label: PLS-SEM Algorithm
features.quickpls_scope: Deterministic PLS path modelling for supported recursive composite models, including weights, loadings, paths, scores, R-squared, effects, assessment tables, persistence, and native export.
known_differences: QuickPLS is independently implemented and does not claim numerical identity for every initialization, sign convention, or stopping path.
Unsupported model shapes remain blocked by the typed recipe validator.

features.label: Weighted PLS
features.quickpls_scope: Positive case-weighted reflective PLS with standardized preprocessing and path or factor weighting.

features.label: GSCA
features.quickpls_scope: Bounded joint global least-squares ALS for standardized raw data, disjoint reflective or formative blocks, and recursive single-group paths; point estimates only.
known_differences: Inference, controls, covariance paths, interactions, higher-order constructs, case weights, and multigroup analysis are not in the current accepted scope.
Historical gsca_v1 is preview-only and is never reinterpreted as v2 evidence.

features.label: CB-SEM / CFA
features.quickpls_scope: Raw-data single-group reflective CFA or recursive SEM with maximum likelihood, marker identification, standardized and unstandardized parameters, residuals, fit indices, and residual-based modification screening.
known_differences: Mean structures, robust ML, ordinal WLSMV, FIML, bootstrap, unrestricted multigroup invariance, interactions, and higher-order models remain outside this workflow.
The current estimator is independently validated against external references but does not bundle an external statistical runtime.

features.label: Structural Path Randomization
features.quickpls_scope: Single-model Freedman-Lane structural path randomization under documented fixed-score linear nuisance assumptions.
known_differences: This is single-model path randomization, not multigroup analysis.
Current evidence proves the engine and responsive native setup, but the current packaged acceptance report does not contain a completed result, export, and same-run reopen for this workflow.

features.label: MICOM and Two-Group Permutation MGA
features.quickpls_scope: Two-group MICOM v2 plus deterministic two-tailed permutation comparisons for paths, outer loadings, and outer weights with explicit Group A minus Group B direction.
known_differences: Current native scope is two groups and permutation MGA coupled to MICOM; PLS-MGA, parametric, Welch, and consistent MGA variants remain pending.
Translation, coding meaning, and substantive measurement equivalence remain researcher responsibilities.

features.label: PLSpredict / CVPAT
features.quickpls_scope: Indicator-first seeded repeated 10-fold prediction with indicator-average and linear-model benchmarks plus single-model CVPAT; deterministic holdout remains secondary.

CVPAT compares one fitted model with IA and LM benchmarks; saved-model comparison is pending Wave 5.
